# Andy Evans — Senior Software Engineer (.NET & Azure)

> Andy Evans is a senior software engineer and platform engineer based in Sheffield, UK, with over
> 12 years of experience building production software. He works primarily in C# and .NET, and leads
> on platform engineering, CI/CD and Azure cloud deployments. He is currently a Senior Software
> Developer at Razor Ltd, a software consultancy.

Currently open to conversations about Senior/Lead Software Engineer (.NET), Platform Engineer /
DevOps Engineer, and Solution Architect / Technical Lead roles. Remote (UK), open to hybrid around
Sheffield and South Yorkshire. Contact via LinkedIn.

## Core skills

- Languages: C#, .NET 8, .NET Framework, ASP.NET Core, TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Kotlin, SQL
- Cloud and platform: Microsoft Azure, Azure Functions, Durable Functions, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Kubernetes, Helm, Infrastructure as Code, Cloudflare, AWS, on-prem infrastructure
- DevOps and CI/CD: Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, build and release automation, Docker, containerisation, Git
- Data: SQL Server, Entity Framework Core, Oracle Database
- Testing: XUnit, NUnit, TestContainers, functional testing, integration testing, test automation
- Web and APIs: REST APIs, microservices, Vue, Nuxt, AngularJS, WPF
- Architecture and leadership: software architecture, technical leadership, mentoring, backlog management, user stories and estimation, agile delivery, client workshops

## Selected technical writing

- [Ephemeral environments with Kubernetes and Azure DevOps in the cloud](https://andyevans.dev/posts/ephemeral-environments-with-kubernetes-and-azure-devops/): Giving developers and testers on-demand throwaway deployments on AKS.
- [Testing Durable Azure Function Apps using XUnit and TestContainers](https://andyevans.dev/posts/testing-durable-azure-functions-with-xunit-and-testcontainers/): Functional testing for containerised serverless workloads.
- [Functional Testing for .NET 8 Isolated Azure Functions](https://andyevans.dev/posts/functional-testing-with-isolated-azure-functions/): Testing HTTP-triggered isolated functions with UnitTestEx.
- [Tackling badly-written software](https://andyevans.dev/posts/tackling-badly-written-software/): Turning a tangled codebase into a simple one.
- [Hosting an Azure Functions API for an Azure DevOps Extension](https://andyevans.dev/posts/hosting-a-backend-api-for-an-azure-devops-extension/): Securely hosting a backend API for a DevOps extension.
- [Azure DevOps Web Extensions with Vue](https://andyevans.dev/posts/azure-devops-web-extensions-with-vue/): Building a DevOps extension with a statically generated Nuxt site.
